# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) in the repository root before making any change.
It is the single source of truth for the rules in this project and it is binding.

AGENTS.md requires two further documents, both of which must be read before
writing code:

- [docs/code-style.md](../docs/code-style.md) — how code is written here
- [docs/security.md](../docs/security.md) — rules that must hold in every change

Do not duplicate rules into this file.
